It is a *thinking-led AI challenge*. Students are evaluated on how well they: - frame real-world problems - apply AI reasoning responsibly - explain decisions using evidence and logic The format uses a *structured, worksheet-driven methodology* that makes reasoning visible, not just outcomes. *Register Now* *Event details at a glance* - *Dates:* February 06–08, 2026 - *Format:* 72-hour Pan-India event (Remote / Hybrid) - *Eligibility:* UG and PG students from Engineering, Science, Management, Healthcare, and Design - *Team size:* Exactly three students per team (cross-disciplinary teams encouraged) - *Domains:* AI for Social Good, Education, Medicine & Healthcare, Applied Engineering *Key milestones* - *Jan 05:* Program launch and registrations open - *Jan 31:* Registrations close - *Feb 06:* Problem statement release and mandatory industry masterclasses - *Feb 07:* Design, system architecture, and reasoning refinement - *Feb 08:* Evaluation, jury deep-dives (Top 40 teams), and grand finale We request you to share this opportunity with your students and encourage participation. Full details and registration are available at: *https://clic.getkruu.com/ * . *For more information, your office or the student leads may contact* *clic@getkruu.com .* We look forward to engaging with the problem-solvers and thinkers from your institution. subject: Join us in our next UiPath Community event in 3 days
body: Join us in our next upcoming event Connector Corner: Autopilot to Agents: Conversational AI for Every Role Date & time: Thu, Apr 23, 3:00 PM (EDT) Agenda: About this UiPath Community eventJoin us for a deep dive into UiPath Autopilot—the AI-powered productivity layer built directly into the UiPath Platform that transforms how every person in your organization works, regardless of technical skill.About This EventAutopilot isn't a single feature—it's a productivity philosophy embedded across the entire UiPath ecosystem. Whether you're a business user trying to move faster, a developer building automations, or a tester managing quality at scale, Autopilot meets you where you are and amplifies what you can do. In this 90-minute session, we'll break down exactly how Autopilot works across different roles and surfaces—and why it matters for enterprise-wide AI adoption.We'll explore how Autopilot for Everyone turns natural language instructions into automated actions across applications, how Autopilot for Developers accelerates automation build time in Studio, and how Autopilot for Testers eliminates the friction of manual test case creation. Along the way, we'll look at real cross-departmental use cases and close with a live demo showing Autopilot moving from a plain-English request all the way through to a triggered automation—no code subject: Cisco Virtual Internship Program (VIP) 2026 – Registration - FREE OF COST/25th April 2026
body: Dear Students, In collaboration with AICTE, Cisco has introduced the latest phase of the Virtual Internship Program with a continued focus on strengthening India’s digital talent ecosystem. This year, the program includes a new track in Artificial Intelligence (AI), along with Cyber Security and Networking, delivered through the Cisco Networking Academy. *Program Highlights:* • Gain technical knowledge and skills by completing Cisco Networking Academy courses in the identified tracks. • Learn to utilize the powerful network simulation tool, Packet Tracer. • Engage in an industry session hosted by Cisco experts and leaders, covering topics from fostering global skill set to careers in cybersecurity and networking. • Accredited Networking Academy instructors will train faculty members from participating institutions to serve as local mentors. • With guidance from local mentors, shortlisted students will work on projects to address identified problem statements. Registration Link: https://internship.aicte-india.org/cisco.php *Last date to register: 25th April 2026* Regards Philip Praveen I REC

subject: Re: Cisco Virtual Internship Program (VIP) 2026 – Information for NetAcad Institutions
body: Gentle Reminder, Dear Students, Greetings from ICT Academy! We are pleased to share an exciting update from our partner regarding the launch of the *Cisco Virtual Internship Program (VIP) 2026*, building on the tremendous success of previous editions which witnessed over 350,000 enrollments across Cyber Security, Networking, and Cloud Security. In collaboration with AICTE, Cisco has introduced the latest phase of the Virtual Internship Program with a continued focus on strengthening India’s digital talent ecosystem. This year, the program includes a *new track in Artificial Intelligence (AI)*, along with *Cyber Security and Networking*, delivered through the Cisco Networking Academy. *Program Highlights:* - Gain technical knowledge and skills by completing Cisco Networking Academy courses in the identified tracks. - Learn to utilize the powerful network simulation tool, Packet Tracer. - Engage in an industry session hosted by Cisco experts and leaders, covering topics from fostering global skillset to careers in cybersecurity and networking. - Accredited Networking Academy instructors will train faculty members from participating institutions to serve as local mentors. - With guidance from local mentors, shortlisted students will work on projects to address identified problem statements. *Eligibility:* - Students from 1st, 2nd, and 3rd year of technical degree programs (B.Tech, B.E, BCA, BSc IT/CS, MCA, MSc IT/CS) - Diploma students in 1st or 2nd year - Must be enrolled in Cisco Networking Academy *Important Note:* VIP 2026 is a *preferred pre-requisite for Ideathon 2026*, making it highly beneficial for students aspiring to secure full-time internship opportunities with Cisco. *Registration Details:* Registration Link: https://internship.aicte-india.org/cisco.php *Last date to register: 25th April 2026* We look forward to your support in making this initiative a great success. subject: Re: Cisco Virtual Internship Program (VIP) 2026 – Information for NetAcad Institutions
body: Gentle Reminder, Dear Students, Greetings from ICT Academy! We are pleased to share an exciting update from our partner regarding the launch of the *Cisco Virtual Internship Program (VIP) 2026*, building on the tremendous success of previous editions which witnessed over 350,000 enrollments across Cyber Security, Networking, and Cloud Security. In collaboration with AICTE, Cisco has introduced the latest phase of the Virtual Internship Program with a continued focus on strengthening India’s digital talent ecosystem. This year, the program includes a *new track in Artificial Intelligence (AI)*, along with *Cyber Security and Networking*, delivered through the Cisco Networking Academy. *Program Highlights:* - Gain technical knowledge and skills by completing Cisco Networking Academy courses in the identified tracks. - Learn to utilize the powerful network simulation tool, Packet Tracer. - Engage in an industry session hosted by Cisco experts and leaders, covering topics from fostering global skillset to careers in cybersecurity and networking. - Accredited Networking Academy instructors will train faculty members from participating institutions to serve as local mentors. - With guidance from local mentors, shortlisted students will work on projects to address identified problem statements. *Eligibility:* - Students from 1st, 2nd, and 3rd year of technical degree programs (B.Tech, B.E, BCA, BSc IT/CS, MCA, MSc IT/CS) - Diploma students in 1st or 2nd year - Must be enrolled in Cisco Networking Academy *Important Note:* VIP 2026 is a *preferred pre-requisite for Ideathon 2026*, making it highly beneficial for students aspiring to secure full-time internship opportunities with Cisco. *Registration Details:* Registration Link: https://internship.aicte-india.org/cisco.php *Last date to register: 25th April 2026* We look forward to your support in making this initiative a great success. subject: April Picks: Hackathons You Shouldn't Miss
body: Hey Ishitha, April's stacking up fast. Two hackathons, two cities, and rooms full of builders. Here's what's worth your time this week: Hackathon Spotlight: Push to Prod Hackathon with Genspark and Claude Push to Prod is an in-person hackathon happening in Singapore this April, in collaboration with Anthropic , Genspark , and Temasek . Builders are tasked with solving one problem: how can AI streamline work by automating repetitive tasks, improving team coordination and decision-making, and reducing operational overhead? What to expect: 5 hours building in person with access to Claude and Genspark Mentorship and a chance to win prizes for the best projects Event details: Dates: April 24, 2026 Happening: In-person, Singapore Rewards: $18,200 worth of credits Apply now → push-to-prod.devfolio.co Deadline to apply → April 11, 2026 Coming Up: ETHPrague 2026 The fifth edition of the longest-running recurring hackathon in the same city in Europe is taking place in Prague's Municipal House. We believe that building in the grand Smetana Hall will be a truly unforgettable experience for all hackers. It is a three-day event where hundreds of builders, from coders to designers, come together to create innovative Ethereum projects. The hackathon features three main tracks: Ethereum Core , Network Economy , and Future Society , along with additional prizes. Event details: Dates: May 8 – 10, 2026 Happening: In-person, Czechia Prize pool: $35,000 Apply now → ethprague2026.devfolio.co Deadline to apply → April 30, 2026 Two different stages, one common thread shows up, build something real, and put it out into the world. subject: Gentle Reminder : Cisco Virtual Internship Program (VIP) 2026 – Information for NetAcad Institutions
body: Dear Students, Greetings from ICT Academy! We are pleased to share an exciting update from our partner regarding the launch of the *Cisco Virtual Internship Program (VIP) 2026*, building on the tremendous success of previous editions which witnessed over 350,000 enrollments across Cyber Security, Networking, and Cloud Security. subject: The Monthly Build - Google Developer Program - April 2026
body: Google Developer Program Written by Richard Seroter BUILDER SPOTLIGHT: Everybody builds. Google AI Studio just changed the game for builders. Full-stack vibe coding with production-grade database and authentication options, along with a stronger coding agent. Create multiplayer experiences, take advantage of modern web tools, and continue your build sessions over long periods. Bring your ideas to life like never before. For many, this takes the place of the Firebase Studio experiment, and clarifies your choices. Read the launch post! Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite is our fastest and most efficient Gemini 3 series model Build better with the fast and cost-efficient Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite. This excellent Gemini 3 series model is designed to give you tremendous performance at a fraction of the cost of larger models. It’s great at reasoning and multimodal understanding. Try it out in AI Studio and Vertex AI. Learn more Google offers many MCP servers including fully managed ones and new open ones like this one from Colab Build smarter with MCP servers from Google. Did you know that Google offers over a dozen fully managed MCP servers so that your tools and agents can more easily “talk” to their favorite services? Whether Google Maps or Cloud services like BigQuery, Firestore, Vertex AI, and Cloud Run, you get easy access to safe, available endpoints. And don’t miss the new open source Colab MCP server that lets you treat notebooks as tools! Googler Aron Eidelman explains how to build production AI agents that are protected and responsible with data Build safer with ADK and Antigravity. Aron’s got a great video that explains what it means to protect your custom agents with products like Model Armor, while preventing data leakage and other risks. See how the Agent Development Kit and Google Antigravity help along the way. Learn more FAST FIVE [Devices] Now Available: New Support for Setup & Reset Instructions for Matter Devices. You can now provide a tailored setup experience for your Matter Plugs and Lights within the Google Home app. Use the Developer Console to upload step-by-step instructions and visual assets (like LED pulse animations) for Setup and Reset modes. This update helps users confirm device behavior in real-time, leading to a 10% increase in commissioning success rates. [Cloud] Secure your Cloud Run apps with on-click IAP integration. Identity-aware proxy (IAP) gives you control over who can access your application, whether that’s inside or outside of your organization. You can now enable this for Cloud Run services with one-click in the console, a single gcloud CLI flag, or one Terraform configuration. [Android] Evaluate LLM capabilities for Android development with Android Bench. We just delivered the first version of this leaderboard of LLMs for Android development. We used real-world Android development scenarios to ensure we had a realistic assessment. Check out the first results! [Firebase] Firebase A/B testing now available for the web. Run, analyze, and scale experiments with Firebase A/B testing. This popular capability for mobile devs is now available for those building Firebase web apps too. [Stitch] Create and iterate on designs using natural language in the upgraded Stitch. I really like using this service. And now it’s even better. This product evolution makes it easier to explore ideas quickly and work within a new infinite canvas to iterate on your work. This, and much more in the latest update. LEVEL UP WITH LEARNING Go from design-to-code with Antigravity and Stitch Take a look at this brand-new codelab which teaches us how to build high-fidelity UIs in Stitch, and connect them to Antigravity using the Stitch MCP server. Start learning Read the developer’s guide to AI agent protocols Can’t tell your MCP from your AP2? Don’t feel bad, it’s a lot to keep up with. Take advantage of posts like this one that breaks down the core protocols that matter for AI agent developers. It includes code samples for each! Read more DEVELOPER COMMUNITY Angular community experts share what they’re learning Many of us are not just changing what we build, but how we build. This roundup of resources and examples from Angular community experts may inspire you to try some new patterns. Read the article Query images and videos directly in BigQuery Is there anything BigQuery can’t do? I’m always amazed by its power and flexibility. This post explores the way to query structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data—thanks BigLake Object Tables!—without leaving BigQuery. subject: Zoho - CATALYST A hands on session program
body: *Dear Students,* *Zoho - Catalyst Campus Program* is a hands-on workshop session scheduled for *Monday (20 Apr 2026)* at our campus. Eligible students who are sure to attend this program are informed to register on or *before tomorrow (03-Apr-2026) by 9:30 AM.* About Catalyst Catalyst is Zoho's serverless cloud development platform — designed to help developers build, deploy, and scale applications without managing infrastructure. It's used in production environments across industries and is the same platform our own engineers build on. What is the Catalyst Campus Program This program addresses that directly. In addition to teaching students about the platform through lectures or demos through the curriculum program, we bring them into structured, hands-on build sessions where they design and deploy real applications themselves. Every student who goes through the program leaves with at least one production-grade application they've built and the ability to explain the design decisions behind it. What this looks like on the ground We'll begin with a workshop session — a 90–120 minute hands-on build session for the students, focused on real problem-solving and system design. From there, we work with the college to set up an officially recognised Catalyst Campus Club, supported by a structured milestone roadmap, build resources, rewards and direct access to the Catalyst team. Clubs progress through milestones based on what their students have built. We will also maintain a public leaderboard that tracks deployed projects across all participating colleges — giving students visibility and recognition for what they've actually created. Who this is for The program is open to students across CS, IT, and ECE departments. *Note:* 1. Students are required to bring a laptop on the day of the session. 2. Up to 2 standing arrears are eligible *Registration Link:* https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe7HGZlkKiUyMslZQjXSUCmX0wjqrhOMo-nAJTAB1Z8cwXDMA/viewform?usp=dialog Regards, Philip Praveen. subject: Clarification regarding fee - Reg.
body: Dear Students, With reference to our earlier mail regarding fee payment and hostel booking, please be informed that the dayscholar students are required to pay the same fee amount that was paid last year as part of the current fee payment. Hostel fee will differ based on the category of the room selected. Students under the REC Visionary Scholarship are requested to follow these steps: Click on “Pay Other Fee” Enter the amount paid last year Complete the payment Once the payment is made, the remaining balance fee will be waived off, and the updated fee details will be reflected in the Digii portal. Students who notice any discrepancies in the fee amount are requested to kindly meet the SAO in the Admin Office during their free hours for clarification. Regards, SAO

subject: Fee intimation & Hostel booking - Academic Year 2026-27 - Reg.
body: Dear Student, Greetings from Rajalakshmi Engineering College! I hope you and your family are doing well. As we step into another academic year, I would like to take this opportunity to share some key updates about our institution and the progress we have made over the past year. Despite a rapidly evolving educational and industry landscape, REC has continued to uphold its commitment to excellence in academics, research, and student placements. *Outstanding Placement Achievements* We are proud to share that the placement season for the 2025–2026 batch has been exceptionally successful. Over 1,751+ job offers have been secured so far, with three more months remaining in the placement cycle. Several leading companies, including TCS, Cognizant, Accenture, Capgemini, JP Morgan Chase & Co., BNY Mellon, PwC India, Amazon, EY Global Delivery Services, EdgeVerve Systems, LTIMindtree, L&T Technology Services, SAP Labs, Siemens Technology & Services, Comcast India, Bosch Limited, GE Vernova, Hitachi Energy, JSW Group, Reliance Industries, BNP Paribas India Solutions, Temenos, Mu Sigma Business Solutions, Deloitte (HashedIn Technologies), Securin Labs, Hexaware Technologies, Zoho Corporation, Thoughtworks, Prodapt, Trimble, Stellantis Automobiles India, and Ultratech Cement, among others, have recruited our students. We have recorded 360+ Dream and Super Dream offers, further reinforcing our reputation as a premier institution for career-oriented education and industry-ready talent. Research and Innovation at REC Our faculty members and students have been actively engaged in cutting-edge research projects, securing funding from prestigious organizations such as DST, DRDO, BRNS, ICMR, SERB, AICTE, and UGC. The college has received over Rs. 27 crores in research grants and completed more than 100 projects in emerging technology areas. To foster interdisciplinary research, we have 15 Centers of Excellence focusing on high-impact domains. Furthermore, REC has strengthened its collaboration with leading industries, IITs, national research labs, and global universities, ensuring that our students and faculty are at the forefront of innovation and industry advancements. *Technology-Driven Education* As we embrace the future, REC continues to integrate Artificial Intelligence (AI) and emerging technologies into various academic and administrative processes. Our commitment to digital transformation ensures that students gain hands-on experience with advanced tools, equipping them with the skills required for modern industries. *Fee Payment Details* As we prepare for the next academic year, we kindly remind you that the college fee for the academic year 2026-2027 is due by *April 30, 2026*. Despite inflationary pressures, we have maintained the fee structure unchanged to support our students and their families. Please note that from the Academic year 2026-27, all fee payments will be accepted through Digii portal *ONLY. NO CHEQUE OR CASH PAYMENTS WILL BE ACCEPTED.* *Hostel Accommodation* All students who wish to avail hostel accommodation for the Academic year 2026-2027 are required to register their willingness and complete the prescribed payment through the Digii Portal by 30th April,2026. The detailed process of using the Digii Portal for booking the Hostel is available as a manual attached with this email. This process of booking through Digii Portal will enable us to effectively plan and allocate hostel facilities in a streamlined and transparent manner. Please note that hostel room allocation will be strictly on a *first-come, first-served* basis, based on the date and time of successful payment. Further, once the payment is completed, *no requests for change of hostel room will be entertained under any circumstances*. *Important Note on Exempted Categories in Hostel Room booking* The following categories of students are *not required to register or make payment through the Digii Portal*: · Students belonging to *Maatram, Anandham, and Agaram Foundations* (both existing hostel residents and those day scholars seeking accommodation for the next academic year) · Students admitted under the *7.5% Government Quota* (both existing hostel residents and those day scholars seeking accommodation for the next academic year) · Students belonging to the *NRI Category* (both existing hostel residents and those day scholars seeking accommodation for the next academic year) · *Existing hostel students* from the *16 bus routes that were discontinued* during the current academic year, and who wish to continue to make use of the hostel accommodation for the next academic year. Students falling under the above categories are requested to *approach the Senior Administrative Officer directly* and indicate their willingness to avail hostel accommodation for the next academic year through the *offline process available at the College Admin Office before 30th April,2026*. They are *NOT REQUIRED to use the Digii Portal* for registration or payment. *Minors /Honours * As you are aware, those admitted in the 2024-25 batch and moving to the 5th semester in the Academic Year 2026-27 are given the option of pursuing a Minor Degree or Honors introduced by Anna University. Students who meet the required academic criteria and wish to enroll in a Minor Degree or Honors will have to pay an additional fee. The list of eligible students who meet the criteria will be informed through mail and interested students from that list may pay an additional fee fixed by the Institution at a later date. We deeply appreciate your continued support in our mission to provide quality education and holistic development for you/your ward. We look forward to another year of academic excellence and success. PRINCIPAL
